title: vincetoxicum officinale var. luteolum
intro: Vincetoxicum officinale var. luteolum, commonly known as Yellow Swallowwort, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its health benefits of reducing pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Swallowwort include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Swallowwort, including vincetoxicine and luteolin, contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
